title: Corpus membership: what retrieval is permitted to quote
note: Every guard on a corpus path protected its SHAPE. None protected the SET, so writing a file into the tree made it governed text a reader would be handed with the retrieval layer's provenance on it. These mutations remove one link each between 'this file exists' and 'this file was reviewed into the corpus'.

mutations.name: C1_undeclared_documents_enter_the_corpus
mutations.rationale: the original defect restored: a document becomes governed text by being created

mutations.name: C2_a_vanished_document_is_not_noticed
mutations.rationale: the reviewed corpus no longer exists and retrieval answers from something else

mutations.name: C3_an_edited_document_is_absorbed_silently
mutations.rationale: the words a governed document is quoted as saying can be changed without review

mutations.name: C4_a_missing_allowlist_reads_as_no_restriction
mutations.rationale: VACUOUS SUCCESS: deleting the allowlist disables the check, so the weakest attack is also the cheapest

mutations.name: C5_an_empty_allowlist_is_accepted
mutations.find: if not isinstance(entries, list) or not entries:
mutations.rationale: a list naming nothing makes every membership check pass by examining nothing

mutations.name: C6_the_allowlists_own_digest_is_not_checked
mutations.rationale: an attacker appends their document to the list; nothing makes that a deliberate regeneration

mutations.name: C7_membership_is_checked_only_against_what_the_caller_named
mutations.rationale: the check becomes optional by argument: pass a subset and the tree's undeclared documents are never looked at

mutations.name: C8_membership_is_not_checked_at_all
mutations.rationale: the mechanism exists and nothing calls it, which is the shape of a defence with no caller
